# Cargo restriction

Every lint of the Cargo `restriction` group that is allowed by default as of Rust 1.100.

| Lint | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`non_kebab_case_features`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/cargo/reference/lints.html#non_kebab_case_features) | Detect feature names that are not kebab-case. |
| [`non_kebab_case_packages`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/cargo/reference/lints.html#non_kebab_case_packages) | Detect package names that are not kebab-case. |
| [`non_snake_case_features`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/cargo/reference/lints.html#non_snake_case_features) | Detect feature names that are not snake-case. |
| [`non_snake_case_packages`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/cargo/reference/lints.html#non_snake_case_packages) | Detect package names that are not snake-case. |
